glossary: Momentum
How much a price has risen over recent months. Winners tend to keep winning for a while.
ATR
Average True Range: the size of a normal day's move, in dollars. Used to set stops and sizes.
Stop
A pre-set price where we sell to cap the damage if something goes badly wrong.
50-day / 200-day average
The average price over the last 50 / 200 trading days. Above = uptrend.
Beta
How much a stock usually moves when the S&P 500 moves 1%. Beta 1.5 = moves about 1.5%.
Rebalance
Bringing each part of the account back to its target share.
Sector ETF
One fund that holds a whole sector (e.g. XLE = US energy companies).
CDR
Canadian Depositary Receipt: a CAD-priced, currency-hedged version of a US stock on the Canadian exchange.
Drawdown
How far the account is below its highest value.
VIX
The market's 'fear gauge'. Below 20 is calm; above 28 is stressed.

Midweek: the market light is YELLOW but calming (VIX 18). Healthcare, staples, consumer and communication lead this week; chips (-7%) and tech (-4%) still lag.
NVDA: the board's independent investigation into the CEO is at an early stage with no findings; Huang stays on as CEO. Congress asked for a briefing by 11 Nov. Earnings are 17 Nov. The stock is about flat against the 167 entry, after a 5% drop yesterday that was mostly company-specific. It is held under the quality-dip rules: no action unless the story breaks or the 108.64 disaster stop hits.
AMD (quality dip) is up 6.5% this week, beating the market.
SNOW and CRWD limit sells (good till Friday) have not filled. CRWD fell another 7.7% this week on company-specific weakness.
Monday's catch-up buys (VOO, MCK, ABBV, V, MA) are still open, and no news argues against them.
